summary: The note is a short biographical sketch of Susan Winchester, who was born in Chickasha, Oklahoma, and studied at the University of Oklahoma, earning bachelor's and master's degrees. It covers her business activities: co-owning and running American Dusting Company and Chickasha Flying Service from 1976 to 1989, then serving as a coordinator at Canadian Valley Technology Center. It ends with her founding of Winchester Group in 1992, an educational firm offering training and consulting to businesses.
one_line: Susan Winchester is an Oklahoma-born educator and businesswoman who ran aviation and dusting firms before founding Winchester Group in 1992.
key_facts: Susan Winchester was born in Chickasha, Oklahoma.
Susan Winchester earned her bachelor's and master's degrees at the University of Oklahoma.
Susan Winchester co-owned and operated American Dusting Company from 1976 to 1989.
Susan Winchester co-owned and operated Chickasha Flying Service from 1976 to 1989.
After 1989, Susan Winchester worked as a coordinator for Adult Training and Development at Canadian Valley Technology Center.
Susan Winchester started Winchester Group in 1992.
Winchester Group is an educational group that provides training and consulting to businesses.
